sources.title: Run Krea 2 Turbo Online — Free, No GPU | AIFLUX
sources.snippet: What is Krea 2? + Krea 2 is an open-weights AI image model from Krea. It ships as a fast Turbo variant (8-12 steps, CFG 1) and a higher-quality Raw variant (25-30 steps, higher CFG). Its text encoder is a Qwen3-VL language model, so it reads natural-language prompts rather than tag lists. Can I run Krea 2 online without a GPU? + Yes.
